action.text: The detect.restored_class criterion requires tests to detect when a subclass is returned instead of the exact InterpolationMissingOptionError. Current code uses assertIsInstance for deep copy and pickle, which accepts subclasses. Fix: change to assertIs(type(...), configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) for both. Shallow copy already uses assertIs correctly. File: Lib/test/test_configparser.py, sha c26b26bc...
